body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> SONY(www.sony.com) introduced 'MHS-TS20', 3-inch screen touch camera at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6. It supports 1920x1080 resolution.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
